locales.description: All supported locales of the model

labels.description:
All labels of the model

A label of a model is a text that can be used to display the model to users for a given locale

description.description:
Optional human-readable description of the model

Can be used to provide additional information about the model, e.g. its usage, content, purpose, change history, etc.

annotations.description:
All annotations of the model

An annotation is a key value pair of strings which can contain any project specific extension.

Header.description: Contains common header information for all types of A12 models.

LocalizedModelText.description:
An array containing the translations for a given model element (property), e.g. a label.

Each array item contains the translation for a single (partial) locale.

locale.description:
The serialized representation of the (partial) locale.

Expected format: \<language\>[_\<COUNTRY\>]

Valid examples: en_US, de_DE, fr

Invalid examples: en-US, en_us, enUS, FR

text.description: The localized text for the given locale.

Query.Operator.description: Aggregated type for all Logic and Search operators.

operands.description: The collection of operands to be evaluated. Result will be true if and only if all the operands are true.
The collection of operands to be evaluated. Result will be true if and only if one or more of its operands is true.

operand.description: The logic operator takes truth to falsity and vice versa.

Query.HasOperator.description: Represents a HAS logic operator. Operator for querying linked documents.

field.description: Name of date field to be evaluated.

value.description: Date value used for reverse range

reverse.description: If true, checks if the specified date or date range is within the range stored in the database. If false (default), checks if the database value is within the specified date range.

Query.DateRangeOperator.description:
Represents a DATE_RANGE logic operator. Any date formats that are defined by `Kernel` are supported.
- Both `from` and `to` are not mandatory but at least one is mandatory.
- Boundaries are included in result.

field.description: Name of date fragment field to be evaluated.

Query.DateFragmentRangeOperator.description:
Represents a DATE_FRAGMENT_RANGE logic operator. Any date formats that are defined by `Kernel` are supported.
- Both `from` and `to` are not mandatory but at least one is mandatory.
- Boundaries are included in result.

field.description: Name of numeric field to be evaluated.

Query.DoubleRangeOperator.description:
Represents a DOUBLE RANGE logic operator. Matches if the value in the field is within a range defined in the operator.
- Both `from` and `to` are not mandatory but at least one is mandatory.
- Boundaries are included in result.

field.description: Name of field to be evaluated.

value.description: Value for comparison with field's value. For matching with number value please use numeric value here, for other types please use `string`. Either this or `values` must be provided.

values.description:
Multiple values to be compared with the field's value.

This is an alternative to the `value` parameter, allowing multiple values to be matched simultaneously. The behavior is similar to `value`, but it matches documents where the field equals any of the specified values (logical OR). Either this or `value` must be provided.

caseSensitive.description: Enable to match exact case-sensitive value.

Query.ExactMatchOperator.description:
Represents an EXACT MATCH search operator. Returns all results that have fields with value that matches exactly the input value. This operator can be applied on types:
- StringType
- DateType
- DateTimeType
- DateFragmentType
- NumberType
- EnumerationType
- BooleanType
- ConfirmType

field.description: Name of field to be evaluated.

value.description: Value for comparison with field's value. For matching with number value please use numeric value here, for other types please use `string`. Either this or `values` must be provided.

values.description:
Multiple values to be compared with the field's value.

This is an alternative to the `value` parameter, allowing multiple values to be matched simultaneously. The behavior is similar to `value`, but it matches documents where the field equals any of the specified values (logical OR). Either this or `value` must be provided.

caseSensitive.description: Enable to match exact case-sensitive value.

Query.DocRefExactMatchOperator.description: Similar to an ExactMatchOperator but exclusively set field to `/__meta/docRef`.

field.description: Name of field to be evaluated.

Query.UndefinedMatchOperator.description: Represents the UNDEFINED_MATCH operator that checks if a given field has value `null` or if it is not present.

fields.description: List of fields to be evaluated. If no fields are specified, the search ranges over all fields of the document.

value.description: Value for comparison with field values.

values.description:
Multiple values to be compared with all fields.

Providing a list of values is faster than combining multiple conditions on the same field with an OR condition.

Query.SimpleSearchOperator.description:
Represents a SIMPLE SEARCH search operator. Return all documents which have fields with a value that contains the input string. This operator can be applied on types:
- StringType

viewMode.description:
Layout mode.
- `"overlay"` — floats above content (default).
- `"docked"` — sits inline beside engine content.
- `"modal"` — centered modal overlay (Dual Pane, Dashboard tiles).

Editor constraints when `viewMode === "modal"` (Editor-enforced; runtime does not validate): Filter Bar must not be modeled, `initialVisibility` must not be `"show"`, Pin/Unpin not exposed.

headerSubtitle.description: Subtitle below the "Filters" title. Recommended for Dual Pane / Dashboard surfaces.

trigger.description: Filter trigger button. Omitted/`enabled: false` → default icon-only button.

showSetFiltersOnly.description: "Show only filters with active criteria" mode in the selector.
